honest_premise: bills service/compute/data access, never validated alpha; G1 UNDER-POWERED retained

api_call.definition: authenticated request returning 2xx/3xx (successful); 4xx incl 429 never billed

backtest_hour.definition: backtest_jobs row reaching status=done, wall-clock started_at->finished_at (locked per-job floor)

drift_response.beyond_tolerance: S1 incident paged; invoicing blocked and flagged
drift_response.extreme: temporary key suspension + S1 + metering.suspend audit row; auto-lift on reconciliation

stripe.idempotency: per-day batch id -> usage record id 1:1
stripe.subscription_item_id: captured from customer.subscription webhook (data.object.items.data[0].id, si_...), stored on the tenant; usage records attach to it, never to the internal tenant_id; paid tenant without one fails loudly, free/trial skipped silently; subscription.deleted clears the linkage

escalation.S1: page on-call immediately; S1 -> incident feed on /v1/status + audit chain; invoicing blocked if metering-related
escalation.S2: respond within target; workaround if available; escalate to S1 on data-integrity or extended outage
escalation.S3: respond within target (business days); batch with the next maintenance window

retention: metering/rollup/billing rows are audit-chain rows, never pruned by the normal retention job
backwards_compat: metering is read-only aggregation; WS-3/4/5 request contract unchanged
amendment_record: v1.2->v1.3 (2026-08-15, T1 alignment): api_call tightened to 2xx/3xx successful requests only — the audit chain records status < 400, so 4xx (incl 429) and 5xx/503 are never billable; conservative and source-exact

v1.1->v1.2 (2026-08-15, T0 conditional approval): drift is S1 + suspension on extreme drift; daily Stripe sync + staleness alert; reconciliation targets = chain(exact) + access logs(tolerance), never Redis limiters
